120.Text: CLAIM: Antifa is an idea, not an organization. | TRUTH: On July 4, 2025, people attacked the Prairieland Detention Center. On June 23, 2026, a court sentenced eight of them. Our view: An idea does not throw a frozen bottle, publish an officer’s address, or fire on a detention center.
